name: 茶水间吧台
reconstruction: counter: two photos fitted jointly (fit_photo.py); lounge: three photos (fit_lounge.py); islands, ceiling slots, cabinet wall: four photos anchored on the counter (fit_island.py); build_scene.py, check_scene.py, preview.py (PLAN.md)
scale_basis: estimated: counter and islands only from the microwave, assumed 0.485 m wide and 0.29 m high; lounge only from its round table, assumed 0.75 m high

photo_overlay.method: phone photos, cameras fitted to the same hand-picked pixels (fit_photo.py), so in-sample; tabletop corners and edges only; not the robot-camera overlay (overlay)

lighting.note: not compared with the head camera

photo_match.method: Isaac RTX from each fitted photo camera (scripts/scenes/render_scenes.py --photos), median CIELAB of photo vs render over the whole frame, averaged over the photos; target |dL*| <= 5, |db*| <= 3; phone auto exposure and white balance make it indicative only

notes: Floor cabinet: the chassis cannot go under it, so the robot stands 7 cm further back (root y = -0.80), lift column raised 0.0765 m each. 6-7 of its convex hulls are not GPU-compatible, so beans fall through them; cam_third is blocked by a board.
